title: DeliverableQA Findings Report
description: The response shape of GET /api/findings (and run_qa.py's findings.json) -- the merged, deduplicated report served to the dashboard. NOT the raw per-agent tool-call payload each specialist agent returns internally (that shape is AgentFindings in agents/schema.py, used only between run_agent() and the merge step).

id.description: Namespaced by owning agent at creation time (e.g. "consistency:1") so it stays globally unique across all 4 agents' output, not just unique per agent run.

merged_from.description: ids of other findings absorbed into this one during merge. Empty unless this finding is the surviving side of a deduplication.

agent.description: The specialist agent that produced this finding. Stamped during merge, not self-reported per-finding by the agent.

counts_by_agent.description: Keyed by agent name; one entry per agent that ran.

top_critical.description: Up to the first 5 critical findings, in report order.

delta.description: Present only when the run was invoked with a previous report to compare against (run_qa.py --previous-findings). Absent from a first-time analysis.

sections.description: Keyed by document section/slide/page label; each value is that section's findings.

agent_errors.description: Present only when one or more (but not all) specialist agents failed and returned no findings. Keyed by agent name, value is a human-readable error summary. The rest of the report reflects only the agents that succeeded. Absent entirely on a fully successful run; if every agent fails, the run raises instead of producing a report at all.
